adversarial_answers.q1_routine: Coefficient monotonicity fails by sign (BH=W^2/n-2c_3, both rise). Majorization is provably unavailable for every n>=5 since star and path spectra cross. No source reduction. Classical Wiener template is the strongest objection but is not a theorem implying the target.
